label: Timeline event
description: One event placed in story time, whether shown on the page, reported, or kept in backstory: what happens, when, who is involved, what brings it about and what it changes. The shape of a whole plotline belongs to Plot.

fields.label: What happens
fields.help: The event itself, set down plainly and in order as a record of what took place, not as the book will narrate it.

fields.label: When it happens
fields.help: When the event takes place in story time, as a date, a character's age, or a marker relative to other events.

fields.label: How firmly the time is fixed
fields.help: How precisely the story pins down when the event happens, which decides how closely later dates and ages must be checked against it.

options.label: Roughly, to a season or a year
Only in relation to events around it

fields.label: Before, during or after the book
fields.help: Whether the event falls before the book's first scene, within the span of its main action, or after its last scene.

fields.label: How long it lasts
fields.help: How long the event lasts in story time, from a single moment to years, and whether it runs without a break or in separate stretches.

fields.label: Who takes part
fields.help: Each person or group who takes part in the event or is present for it, one per item, with a word on their part in it where that helps.

fields.label: Who knows of it
fields.help: Which characters know the event happened, which of them know the full truth of it, and any false or competing version that others believe.

fields.label: What brings it about
fields.help: The decisions, circumstances or earlier events that lead directly to this one, or a note that it arrives without warning.

fields.label: Consequences
fields.help: What changes because the event happened, for those involved, for others and for the course of the story, both at once and later on.

fields.label: Weight in the story
fields.help: How far the event changes the course of the book, from a detail that colours one scene to a turning point the rest of the story depends on.

scaleLabels.high: A turning point for the book

fields.label: How the book renders it
fields.help: Whether the reader meets the event in a scene, in a flashback, in summary or only by implication, or whether it stays in the bible alone.

options.label: Shown in a scene as it happens
Shown later in a flashback or memory
Kept in the bible, never on the page

fields.label: When the reader learns of it
fields.help: Where in the book the reader first learns of the event, whether in full or in pieces, and whether the first version they meet is the true one.

fields.label: Details to keep consistent
fields.help: Facts about the event that later scenes must not contradict, one per item, such as times, injuries, the weather or who was absent.

fields.label: How one leads to the other
fields.help: The chain from the first to the second: what makes the second follow from it, rather than merely come after it.

fields.label: What the reader sees of the link
fields.help: Whether the reader notices the connection as it happens, later on, or only when looking back.

fields.label: What lies between them
fields.help: What happens, or is deliberately left out, between the first and the second.

fields.label: How they fit together
fields.help: What each contributes to the other, and how the part sits within the whole.

fields.label: What sets them apart
fields.help: What one holds that the other lacks, so that the two never blur together.

fields.label: Part played
fields.help: What the one does in or for the other: who acts, who is acted upon, who only looks on.

fields.label: What it leaves behind
fields.help: What this involvement costs, wins or changes for either side once it is over.

fields.label: What holds it together
fields.help: Why this link exists: the need, duty, fear, belief or bargain that keeps it in place.

fields.label: What each side gives and gets
fields.help: What passes between the two because of this link, such as loyalty, protection, money, secrets or obedience.

fields.label: Where it strains
fields.help: The pressure that could break or turn this link, and what would follow if it gave way.

fields.label: How it changes
fields.help: Where this link stands at the start of the book and at its end, and what moves it.
